scripts.cache:clean: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$paths=@('.\\node_modules\\.cache','.\\client\\node_modules\\.cache','.\\.next','.\\.turbo','.\\client\\.vite'); npm cache clean --force; foreach($path in $paths){ Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $path -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -Include *.tsbuildinfo -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
scripts.port:8080:kill: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$port=8080; $processIds=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach($processId in $processIds){ Stop-Process -Id $processId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host ('cleared port ' + $port)"
scripts.port:8081:kill: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$port=8081; $processIds=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach($processId in $processIds){ Stop-Process -Id $processId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host ('cleared port ' + $port)"
scripts.ports:dev:kill: npm run port:8080:kill && npm run port:8081:kill
scripts.android:fresh: npm run client:metro:kill && npm run sync:runtime-config:dev && npm run android:clean && npm run android:uninstall && npm run client:start:reset
scripts.android:fresh:dev: concurrently -k -n metro,server,android -c blue,green,magenta "npm run android:fresh" "npm run server:watch" "npm run android:install -- --no-packager"
scripts.dev:android: npm run sync:runtime-config:dev && concurrently -k -n metro,server,android -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix client run start" "npm run server:watch" "npm --prefix client run android -- --no-packager"
scripts.dev:windows: npm run sync:runtime-config:dev && node ./scripts/run-platform-target.js windows && concurrently -k -n metro,server,windows -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix client run start" "npm run server:watch" "npm --prefix client run windows -- --no-packager"
